title: The Last Salt Revisited
author: D. M. Dunmore
blurb: Mirabel Lockridge, a thief who steals memories, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
